Record Class ScalaTypeData

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.micronaut.scala.processing.visitor.ScalaTypeData
Record Components:
name - The JVM type name
primitive - Whether the type is primitive
arrayDimensions - The array dimensions
interfaceType - Whether the type is an interface
typeArguments - The type arguments
superType - The compiler-resolved super type
interfaces - The compiler-resolved interface types
annotations - The compiler-resolved annotations
annotatedTypeUse - Whether the type reference has type-use annotations
nativeType - The native Scala compiler object
genericPlaceholder - Whether this type is a generic placeholder
variableName - The generic placeholder variable name
bounds - The generic placeholder bounds
wildcard - Whether this type is a wildcard
upperBounds - The wildcard upper bounds
lowerBounds - The wildcard lower bounds
All Implemented Interfaces:
ScalaAnnotatedElementData
public record ScalaTypeData(String name, boolean primitive, int arrayDimensions, boolean interfaceType, Map<String, ScalaTypeData> typeArguments, @Nullable ScalaTypeData superType, List<ScalaTypeData> interfaces, List<ScalaAnnotationData> annotations, boolean annotatedTypeUse, @Nullable Object nativeType, boolean genericPlaceholder, @Nullable String variableName, List<ScalaTypeData> bounds, boolean wildcard, List<ScalaTypeData> upperBounds, List<ScalaTypeData> lowerBounds) extends Record implements ScalaAnnotatedElementData
A reduced Scala type model used by the Element API wrappers.

      newTypeArguments - The resolved type arguments
      Returns:
      The copy

    • resolved

      public ScalaTypeData resolved()
      The type a wildcard stands for, as a plain type: its name and arguments without the bounds. For ? <: Number that is Number and for ? >: Book it is Book, as Core resolves a wildcard argument; for an unbounded wildcard written for a bounded parameter -- Bounded[?] with T <: Number -- it is the parameter's bound, while upperBounds() keeps the Object that was written. A type that is not a wildcard is its own resolution.
      Returns:
      The resolved type

    • equals

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. Reference components are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object); primitive components are compared with the compare method from their corresponding wrapper classes.
      Specified by:
      equals in class Record
      Parameters:
      o - the object with which to compare
      Returns:
      true if this object is the same as the o argument; false otherwise.
